records.jp: そういえば、校内放送の声って、<CR>きりっとしていて憧れたっけ
records.en_original: I always admired how crisp and clear the voice of the person doing the school announcements was.
records.en_auxiliary: I always admired how crisp and clear the voice of the person doing the school announcements was.
records.en: Come to think of it,<CR>I used to admire how crisp and composed the voice over the school announcements sounded.

records.jp: 私だったら、緊張して噛んじゃいそう、<CR>なんて思ってた
records.en_original: If it were me, I'd be so nervous that I'd end up stumbling over my words.
records.en_auxiliary: If it were me, I'd be so nervous that I'd end up stumbling over my words.
records.en: If it were me,<CR>I'd be so nervous that I'd end up stumbling over my words.

records.jp: あー。あー。<CR>ただいまマイクのテスト中〜
records.en_original: Ahh. Ahh. Testing, one-two, testing...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh. Ahh. Testing, one-two, testing...
records.en: Ah. Ah.<CR>We are currently testing the microphone~

records.jp: え。マイク、入っているの！？
records.en_original: Wait. Is the mic on?!
records.en_auxiliary: Wait. Is the mic on?!
records.en: Wait. Is the mic on?!

records.jp: もっちろん！<CR>美弦さんの独り言も、全部校内に流れてるよー
records.en_original: Sure is! You weren't talking to yourself just now, you were talking to the whole school!
records.en_auxiliary: Sure is! You weren't talking to yourself just now, you were talking to the whole school!
records.en: Of course!<CR>Even Mio-san's monologue is being broadcast throughout the school.

records.jp: ええっ！　マ、マイク切って！
records.en_original: Whaaaat?! T-turn it off!
records.en_auxiliary: Whaaaat?! T-turn it off!
records.en: Whaaaat?! T-turn it off!

records.jp: な〜んて、嘘。マイクテストごっこしただけ
records.en_original: Just kidding. I was only pretending to do a mic check.
records.en_auxiliary: Just kidding. I was only pretending to do a mic check.
records.en: Just kidding. I was only pretending to do a mic check.

records.jp: もう。いきなりなんだから。<CR>心臓に悪い冗談は、やめて
records.en_original: You shouldn't do things like that all of a sudden! You almost gave me a heart attack.
records.en_auxiliary: You shouldn't do things like that all of a sudden! You almost gave me a heart attack.
records.en: Honestly.<CR>Don't suddenly make jokes that are bad for my heart.

records.jp: まさかー。<CR>いきなり放送流したら、みんなびっくりしちゃうし
records.en_original: Of course not. Everyone would be shocked if they suddenly heard us talking over the loudspeakers.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course not. Everyone would be shocked if they suddenly heard us talking over the loudspeakers.
records.en: Of course not.<CR>Everyone would be shocked if they suddenly heard us talking over the loudspeakers.

records.jp: あなたに良識があってよかった
records.en_original: I'm glad you have some sense.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad you have some sense.
records.en: I'm glad you have some sense.

records.jp: 良識って、そこまで言う！？
records.en_original: What, you thought I didn't?!
records.en_auxiliary: What, you thought I didn't?!
records.en: Common sense? You'd go that far!?

records.jp: いきなり始めるから、驚いたわ
records.en_original: You startled me. You're always doing things like that all of a sudden.
records.en_auxiliary: You startled me. You're always doing things like that all of a sudden.
records.en: You started so suddenly that it startled me.

records.jp: んー。いきなりかぁ
records.en_original: Hmm... All of a sudden, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... All of a sudden, huh?
records.en: Hmm... All of a sudden, huh?

records.jp: まさか、何か変なことを考えていない？
records.en_original: You're not thinking of doing anything weird, are you?
records.en_auxiliary: You're not thinking of doing anything weird, are you?
records.en: You're not thinking of doing anything weird, are you?

records.jp: さぁ、それはどうでしょー？
records.en_original: Oh, I dunno... What do you think?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I dunno... What do you think?
records.en: Oh, I dunno... What do you think?

records.jp: いま、すごく悪い顔しているわよ
records.en_original: I don't like the face you're making right now... You look like you're about to do something bad.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't like the face you're making right now... You look like you're about to do something bad.
records.en: You have a very wicked look on your face right now.

records.jp: じゃあ、美弦さんも悪くなっちゃおう！
records.en_original: Then let's be bad together, Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: Then let's be bad together, Mio!
records.en: Then let's be bad together, Mio-san!

records.jp: え？　悪くって？
records.en_original: Huh? What do you mean, bad?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What do you mean, bad?
records.en: Huh? What do you mean, bad?

records.jp: やだ！　美弦さんのエッチ！
records.en_original: Eww! Don't be so lewd, Mio!
records.en_auxiliary: Eww! Don't be so lewd, Mio!
records.en: Eww! Mio-san, you pervert!

records.jp: え、エッチ！？
records.en_original: Lewd?!
records.en_auxiliary: Lewd?!
records.en: Pervert?!

records.jp: 私と美弦さんのイチャラブを全校放送しちゃおう<CR>なんて、美弦さんのエッチー！
records.en_original: You really want to broadcast our little hookup to the whole school? Gross!
records.en_auxiliary: You really want to broadcast our little hookup to the whole school? Gross!
records.en: You were thinking of broadcasting all the lovey-dovey flirting between Mio-san and me to the whole school?<CR>Mio-san, you pervert!

records.jp: ふふ。愛央がそこまで言うなら、<CR>期待に応えないといけないかしらね？
records.en_original: Hehe... Well now that you've put it out there, I have to live up to your expectations, don't I?
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe... Well now that you've put it out there, I have to live up to your expectations, don't I?
records.en: Hehe... Well now that you've put it out there,<CR>I have to live up to your expectations, don't I?

records.jp: す、すみません……悪戯が過ぎました
records.en_original: S-sorry... This joke has gone too far.
records.en_auxiliary: S-sorry... This joke has gone too far.
records.en: S-sorry... I took the prank too far.

records.jp: とゆーことで、ふたりで悪戯しちゃわない？
records.en_original: Why don't we play a little prank together?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we play a little prank together?
records.en: Why don't we play a little prank together?

records.jp: な、何をするつもりなの！？<CR>みんなを不安にさせるようなことなら……
records.en_original: Wh-what are you planning?! If it's going to make everyone uncomfortable...
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what are you planning?! If it's going to make everyone uncomfortable...
records.en: Wh-what are you planning?!<CR>If it's something that will make everyone anxious...

records.jp: あ、そんなのじゃないよ！
records.en_original: No, nothing like that!
records.en_auxiliary: No, nothing like that!
records.en: No, nothing like that!

records.jp: 今って、どうせ大きな事件ってないしさ。<CR>ふたりで何か歌って流しちゃわない？
records.en_original: Nothing important is going on right now. Why don't we sing over the school loudspeaker together?
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing important is going on right now. Why don't we sing over the school loudspeaker together?
records.en: There aren't any major incidents right now anyway.<CR>Why don't we sing something together and broadcast it?

records.jp: 歌って放送するということ？
records.en_original: You wanna sing and broadcast it to the whole school?
records.en_auxiliary: You wanna sing and broadcast it to the whole school?
records.en: You wanna sing and broadcast it to the whole school?

records.jp: ね、みんなも楽しくなると思うんだー
records.en_original: Yeah, I think everyone will enjoy it.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I think everyone will enjoy it.
records.en: Yeah, I think everyone will enjoy it.

records.jp: ……私、歌を聞かせるなんて無理よ
records.en_original: ...There's no way I'm singing anything.
records.en_auxiliary: ...There's no way I'm singing anything.
records.en: ...There's no way I'm singing anything.

records.jp: えー。楽しいってー！　多分！
records.en_original: Aww, c'mon! It'll be fun! Maybe!
records.en_auxiliary: Aww, c'mon! It'll be fun! Maybe!
records.en: Aww, c'mon! It'll be fun! Maybe!

records.jp: うーん。ある意味不安にさせちゃうかも？
records.en_original: Hmm. Maybe just a little uncomfortable?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. Maybe just a little uncomfortable?
records.en: Hmm. Maybe we'd make them anxious in a different sense?

records.jp: でも、美弦さんの歌って聞いてみたいし、<CR>ふたりで歌えば……
records.en_original: I've always wanted to hear you sing, Mio. We could sing a song together...
records.en_auxiliary: I've always wanted to hear you sing, Mio. We could sing a song together...
records.en: But I want to hear you sing, Mio-san,<CR>and if we sing together...

records.jp: ま、待って。それはつまり、<CR>私たちの歌を放送で流すということよね！？
records.en_original: H-hold on! You're planning to broadcast us singing to the whole school, aren't you?!
records.en_auxiliary: H-hold on! You're planning to broadcast us singing to the whole school, aren't you?!
records.en: H-hold on!<CR>You're planning to broadcast us singing to the whole school, aren't you?!

records.jp: そーそー。アタマだいじょーぶかーって、<CR>不安にさせるかもだけど、笑いも取れそうだし
records.en_original: Yeah! Everyone will think we've totally lost it. They might be uncomfortable, but it'll be funny!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! Everyone will think we've totally lost it. They might be uncomfortable, but it'll be funny!
records.en: Yeah. They might worry whether we're all right in the head,<CR>but it could get a laugh too.

records.jp: ……待って。それは私が不安になるから却下
records.en_original: ...That'd make me uncomfortable, so I'll have to pass.
records.en_auxiliary: ...That'd make me uncomfortable, so I'll have to pass.
records.en: ...No. Rejected. That would make me anxious.

records.jp: えー。うちの学校、放送部ってＤＪ状態だったよ？<CR>自分たちの歌も流してたし、イケるって！
records.en_original: Aww. The AV club at my school was like a radio station! They'd even play their own songs, it was so cool!
records.en_auxiliary: Aww. The AV club at my school was like a radio station! They'd even play their own songs, it was so cool!
records.en: Aww. The broadcasting club at my school was basically a DJ booth, you know?<CR>They even played their own songs, so we can do it!
